cards.title: What is a phrasal verb?
cards.body: A phrasal verb = verb + particle (up, out, off…). Meaning often not literal.
cards.body_cz: Frázové sloveso = sloveso + částice. Význam často ne doslovný.

cards.title: Separable
cards.body: turn off the light = turn the light off. Pronoun: turn it off.

cards.title: Inseparable
cards.body: look after the kids — not *look the kids after.

cards.title: Chunks
cards.body: pick up · give up · put off · look for · get on with
